visuals: Product image: Tapplock One Smart Padlock
features: ⚡ 【0.5s Ultra-Fast Access & 360° Smart Recognition】Experience lightning-fast entry with the high-resolution fingerprint sensor. Unlock in just 0.5 seconds with advanced 360° recognition—no need to position your finger perfectly. It’s quick, intuitive, and incredibly convenient.

🔋 【Year-Long Power & Massive Fingerprint Storage】Say goodbye to constant charging. A single charge lasts up to 365 days, supporting over 2,000 unlocks. Store up to 20 different fingerprints—perfect for family, friends, or team members sharing lockers, gates, or storage units.

🔑 【Ultra-Low Power & Long-Lasting Battery】 Designed with ultra-low power consumption, it delivers exceptional battery life—allowing you to use it worry-free for up to a full year on a single charge. Perfect for daily high-frequency use or long trips without ever stressing about power.

🛡️ 【Durable, Heavy-Duty Design for All Scenarios】Engineered for long-lasting use with a cut-resistant steel cable and a lock body tested to withstand over 1 million presses. It works flawlessly in extreme temperatures (-10°F to 150°F), perfect for securing gym lockers, luggage, backpacks, bikes, gates, toolboxes, and more.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 【User-Friendly Setup & Smart Management】 Go keyless in minutes. Easily add new fingerprints, manage access, or perform a factory reset using the electronic key. The intuitive system includes a low-battery warning, so you’re never caught off guard. Enjoy secure, key-free simplicity.
